salmanshh_simple_spring.name: Simple Spring
salmanshh_simple_spring.description: Simple numeric spring physics. Springs a value from a start to a target with velocity inheritance.

stiffness.name: Stiffness
stiffness.desc: How quickly spring responds, Increase stiffness for faster response.

damping.name: Damping
damping.desc: How much oscillation is dampened (0-1), Increase damping to reduce overshoot.

precision.name: Precision
precision.desc: Threshold to consider animation complete. Lower values require closer proximity to target.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.desc: Enable or disable the spring behavior.

AddToVelocity.description: Add a value to the spring's current velocity.

Reset.description: Instantly reset the spring value and clear velocity. Stops any active animation. Use this to initialize the spring before the first Spring To call.

SetAlwaysSpring.display-text: Set always spring to target: {0} to {1} (mode: {2})
SetAlwaysSpring.description: When enabled, the spring will continuously spring towards the target value even after reaching it. Useful for following a changing target.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.desc: Enable or disable always spring mode.

target.name: Target
target.desc: The target value to spring towards.

mode.name: Mode
mode.desc: Whether to spring as a value or angle.

SetAlwaysSpringTarget.description: Update the target for always spring mode without changing other settings. Only has an effect when always spring is enabled.

target.name: Target
target.desc: The new target value to spring towards.

SetDamping.description: Set spring damping (0-1). Higher = less oscillation.

SetEnabled.description: Enable or disable the spring behavior.

SetPrecision.description: Set spring precision threshold (0.0001-1). Lower values require the value to be closer to the target before the animation is considered complete.

SetStiffness.description: Set spring stiffness (0-1). Higher = faster response.

SnapToTarget.description: Instantly jump to the target value.

SpringFromTo.description: Spring numeric value from start to target. Inherits velocity if already animating.

SpringFromToAngle.description: Deprecated: use 'Spring to' with Angle mode instead. Spring angle value from start to target, taking the shortest path.

SpringTo.description: Spring to a target value from the current value. Inherits velocity if already animating. Use Angle mode to take the shortest rotational path.

mode.name: Mode
mode.desc: Value: spring a plain number. Angle: take the shortest rotational path (handles 360° wrapping).

Stop.description: Stop the spring animation and keep the current value.

HasReachedTarget.description: True if the spring has reached its target.

IsAlwaysSpringEnabled.description: True if always spring mode is currently enabled.

IsAnimating.description: True if the spring is currently animating.

IsEnabled.description: True if the spring behavior is enabled.

OnReachedTarget.description: Triggered when the spring reaches its target.

OnStarted.description: Triggered when the spring begins a new animation.

OnStopped.description: Triggered when the spring is manually stopped via Stop or Snap to target.

AlwaysSpringTarget.description: Get the current always spring target value.

Progress.description: Get the animation progress from 0 (at start) to 1 (at target).
